nodes.description: State variable creator (address) storing the contract deployer, used as the privileged address in kill().
State variable deposits (uint) counting the number of value-bearing deposits, incremented in deposit().
Constructor PiggyBank() that sets creator = msg.sender and deposits = 0.
Payable fallback function that forwards all plain ether transfers to deposit().
Payable deposit() function that increments deposits when msg.value > 0 and returns getNumberOfDeposits().
Constant getter returning the current value of deposits.
kill() function that selfdestructs the contract to creator when msg.sender == creator.
Caller-controlled address used for the creator assignment and for the kill() authorization check.
selfdestruct(creator) inside kill(), destroying the contract and forwarding the balance.
Arithmetic statement deposits = deposits + 1 executed inside deposit() when msg.value > 0.

edges.reason: Constructor writes the deployer address into the creator state variable.
msg.sender flows into creator during contract construction.
Constructor initializes the deposits counter to zero.
The payable fallback function unconditionally calls deposit().
deposit() executes the deposits + 1 arithmetic statement guarded only by msg.value > 0.
The arithmetic statement writes the incremented value back into the deposits state variable.
deposit() calls getNumberOfDeposits() to obtain its return value.
getNumberOfDeposits() reads the deposits state variable and returns it.
kill() invokes selfdestruct(creator) when the msg.sender == creator authorization check passes.
msg.sender gates access to the selfdestruct call through the creator equality check.
kill() passes the creator state variable as the selfdestruct beneficiary.
kill() branches on the comparison between msg.sender and creator before destroying the contract.
